title: StructuredRepairPatch
description: Strict JSON Schema contract for Meta Muse constrained decoding (text.format.type = json_schema, strict = true) in Spec 060.

explanation.description: Root-cause diagnosis and explanation of the minimal fix.

target_file.description: Relative path to the source file to modify (must not be a test or config file).

search_block.description: Exact contiguous block of lines in target_file to be replaced (must match uniquely).

touched_symbols.description: Function, method, or variable identifiers modified by this patch.
